actual_scope: Independent adversarial audit of open PR #6129 (head f496734450c346468c66818c1c35521165b0cdda): sharp nearest-even normalized Walsh-stage error h(J/3+(1-(-1/2)^J)/9), its odd-output refinement, and its all-grid 3h/4 application to PR #6119 (head bdfe5a10d488b5f774e906d8d4588dc8da25e7ba).
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a proof of an inherited assumption; #6129 claims one precision implication under this card, and a fresh, unreviewed proof is most useful checked independently before anyone relies on it.
bottleneck_link: Side result for precision obligations: confirms (or would refute) a deterministic rounding budget that a deferred-row/Walsh supplier could cite. No supplier, invoice or kappa changes.
stop_rule: Stop after a step-by-step proof review plus independent exact engines reproduce or refute each stated number; report any gap found rather than repairing #6129.
evidence: PROOF.md reviewed step by step: no error. verify.py: residue-tracking tree sets J<=7 (all 2^J sign patterns for J<=4) give even/odd maxima a_J/a_(J-1); literal 8-point network exhaustive on [-3,0]^8 in three orders gives 9/8; rebuilt #6119 surrogate exhaustive per fiber mod 8h gives 3h/4 with #6129's witness; controls: ties-to-odd same law, floor and ties-away reach J/2, ties-to-odd leaves #6119's echo dirty. Local-only: rebuild agrees with #6119 forward() on 3000 random grid inputs.
